topic: Explanation of artificial feel system and helicopter trim system
syllabus_extract: Explanation of artificial feel system and helicopter trim system.
specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AFCS and Trim system schematics; Instructor supervision required for safety regarding hydraulic lines.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the artificial feel system?
Why is a trim system necessary in a helicopter?
How does the pilot's control input relate to the main rotor torque?

development.content:
Purpose of Artificial Feel System
Components of AFCS
Hydraulic Boost Mechanism
Feedback Force Generation
Safety Valves and Limits

Helicopter Trim System Overview
Trim Wheel Operation
Trim Cable and Pulley Arrangement
Effect on Main Rotor Pitch
Trim Indicator Function

Interaction between AFCS and Trim
Pilot Workload Reduction
System Failures and Contingencies
Maintenance Checks
Operational Procedures

summary_questions: Explain how the artificial feel system compensates for control forces.
Describe the sequence of operation when adjusting the trim wheel.
Identify two potential failure modes in the AFCS and their effects.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the trim system settings change during different phases of flight (hover, climb, cruise) to be discussed in the next lesson on actuators.

pft_rows.syllabus: Explanation of various types of actuators series and parallel and combine.
